cases.input: Documents have unique string id, string-list labels, integer created_at and boolean archived fields. Given a label string, return each document with an exactly equal labels member once. Use case-sensitive equality without whitespace normalization. Include archived records and order by created_at descending followed by id ascending. Empty or whitespace-only input is invalid_label. No matching document means an empty collection. This is read-only in memory and on disk, including failures and missing files.
